question: Get products with product line description

question: Get payments with customer country
sql:
SELECT "checkNumber", "paymentDate", "amount", "country" 
FROM payments 
JOIN customers 
ON payments."customerNumber" = customers."customerNumber"

question: Count customers per country
sql:
SELECT "country", COUNT("customerNumber") 
FROM customers 
GROUP BY "country"

question: Total payments per customer
sql:
SELECT "customers"."customerNumber", SUM("amount") 
FROM "customers" 
JOIN "payments" ON "customers"."customerNumber" = "payments"."customerNumber" 
GROUP BY "customers"."customerNumber"

question: Number of orders per status
sql:
SELECT "status", COUNT("orderNumber") 
FROM orders 
GROUP BY "status"

question: Products per product line
sql:
SELECT p."productLine", p."productName" 
FROM products p 
JOIN productlines pl 
ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine"

question: Employees per office
sql:
SELECT "offices"."officeCode", "offices"."city", COUNT("employees"."employeeNumber") 
FROM "employees" 
JOIN "offices" ON "employees"."officeCode" = "offices"."officeCode" 
GROUP BY "offices"."officeCode", "offices"."city"
